arguments.message: Hi! Yes, each plan has a maximum number of seats. You can see the limit and how many seats are currently used in Settings → Billing → Plan. If you’re hitting the limit, you can either add extra seats (if your current tier allows purchasing more) or upgrade to a higher tier.
